name: Blinding Flare
body:
School evocation; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a masterwork arrowhead and a bit of tinder)

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Target one missile weapon
Duration 1 round + 1 round/3 levels
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell focuses upon an arrow, javelin or other missile weapon. Once the spell is cast, the weapon in question glows slightly. Either at the height of its arc or when it strikes its target (your choice), the weapon suddenly erupts into a burst of light, as if a star had appeared from nowhere. Anyone looking at the weapon, or within 30 feet of it, must succeed on a Will save or be blinded for one round. If the weapon misses its target, the spell goes off when it strikes the ground.
